what: CenterPoint Energy delivers electricity in the Houston area and natural gas across six states. Houston's growth and its exposure to hurricanes both define the business.
customers: About 2.9 million electricity customers around Houston and 4.5 million gas customers across Texas, Indiana, Minnesota, Ohio and Louisiana.
money: regulated electricity delivery in and around Houston
regulated gas delivery across six states
moat: A delivery monopoly in one of the fastest-growing metropolitan areas in the United States, with rates set by Texas regulators.
risks: Hurricane Beryl outages drew heavy political and regulatory criticism
Texas regulators determine how much storm hardening investment it can recover
Return on invested capital of about 5%
opportunities: Houston population and data centre growth drive the strongest load forecasts in its history
Grid resilience investment adds to the base it earns a regulated return on
watch: Houston load growth and approval of resilience spending.
